title: A Holiday in London
setting: Busy streets in central London with tall buildings and a green park.

characters.name: Mia
characters.look: Mia, a young girl with short black hair and a red sweater

characters.name: Sam
characters.look: Sam, a young boy with brown hair and a blue jacket

sentences.en: Mia and Sam are on holiday in London.
sentences.zh: 米娅和萨姆在伦敦度假。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia, a young girl with short black hair and a red sweater and Sam, a young boy with brown hair and a blue jacket smile near a big clock tower and a red bus.

sentences.en: At home, they live in a small village.
sentences.zh: 在家里，他们住在一个小村庄。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia, a young girl with short black hair and a red sweater and Sam, a young boy with brown hair and a blue jacket wave in front of a few small cottages among green fields.

sentences.en: London is a very big and busy city.
sentences.zh: 伦敦是一座又大又繁忙的城市。
sentences.scene_prompt: A wide view of a big busy city with many people, cars and buses.

sentences.en: They stay in a flat on a busy street.
sentences.zh: 他们住在一条热闹街道上的一套公寓里。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia, a young girl with short black hair and a red sweater and Sam, a young boy with brown hair and a blue jacket look out of a flat window at a busy street below.

sentences.en: In the town centre, they find a post office.
sentences.zh: 在市中心，他们找到了一家邮局。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia, a young girl with short black hair and a red sweater and Sam, a young boy with brown hair and a blue jacket walk up to a post office in the middle of town.

sentences.en: Sam sends a postcard to Grandma's house.
sentences.zh: 萨姆给奶奶家寄了一张明信片。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sam, a young boy with brown hair and a blue jacket drops a postcard into a red post box while Mia, a young girl with short black hair and a red sweater watches.

sentences.en: Workers build a tall building in this area.
sentences.zh: 工人们在这个地区建一栋高楼。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia, a young girl with short black hair and a red sweater and Sam, a young boy with brown hair and a blue jacket watch workers in hard hats build a tall building with a crane.

sentences.en: Then they rest in a big green park.
sentences.zh: 然后他们在一个绿油油的大公园里休息。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia, a young girl with short black hair and a red sweater and Sam, a young boy with brown hair and a blue jacket sit on the grass under a tree in a big green park.
